notablePrerequisites: The Reality Chip attached to any other creature you control.
description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Golgari Thug, adding {B}.
Golgari Thug dies, putting itself from your graveyard on top of your library.
Cast Golgari Thug from the top of your library by paying {B}.
Bontu's Monument triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.
